title: Empty Layout
description: Unused-code rule — layouts with no layout objects at all. Usually placeholders that were never built out.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: An empty layout serves no purpose and clutters the layout list.
rule.remediation: Build the layout out or delete it.
